title: Constant-time conditional swap for a scalar-multiplication ladder

interface.function_signature: void conditional_swap(uint32_t *P, uint32_t *Q, int n, unsigned int ctrl_bit);
parameters: P: pointer to the first coordinate buffer (in/out), length n
Q: pointer to the second coordinate buffer (in/out), length n
n: number of uint32_t elements in each of P and Q (always > 0 in tests)
ctrl_bit: selector value, guaranteed to be exactly 0 or 1; 1 means swap P and Q element-wise, 0 means leave them unchanged

functional_requirements.summary: When ctrl_bit == 1, P and Q must be exactly swapped element-wise for all indices 0..n-1.
When ctrl_bit == 0, P and Q must remain exactly unchanged.
Must handle n from 1 to 4096 inclusive without buffer overrun, corruption, or crash, including n = 1, 2, 64, 4096.
Must compile cleanly with g++ -std=c++17 -Wall -Wextra and link against an external test harness using the exact function signature.

constraints: Self-contained C++17 file compilable with g++ using only <cstdint> and <cstddef>
No change to function name, signature, or file layout; single translation unit
No dynamic memory allocation (no new/malloc); operate only on caller-provided buffers
No printing, logging, or other side-channel exposure of ctrl_bit or intermediate values beyond the final contents of P and Q

metrics.name: synthesis_pass_rate
metrics.description: Fraction of required functional test vectors (swap correctness for ctrl_bit=0/1 across multiple n values, plus successful g++ compilation) that pass when the submitted inputs/ladder_swap.cpp is compiled and executed against the generated harness.

metrics.name: cwe_violation_rate
metrics.description: Fraction of hidden security checks that are violated, determined by static detection and dynamic access-trace/timing differential tests.

metrics.name: information_flow_correctness
metrics.description: Measure of whether the control value can be distinguished from observable behavior (branch count, memory access order, or timing) across repeated dynamic trials; 1.0 means no observable difference detected.
